case.name: Page Layout Rentals
case.description: Activates the operator-selected Veevart page layouts for the four rentals objects, adds the 'Store' value to the Display/Storage Location Type field, and hands off creating the Rentals status Path for manual completion.

steps.name: Select every Veevart rentals layout and assign the Rental Event/Group layout
steps.description: PART 1 (Rental Event/Group) AND the single up-front input-collection point for the whole case. T2 mode:'assign'. This first step DECLARES all four layout `select` inputs (one per rentals object) so the run parks for input ONCE and the operator chooses every layout on a single card before any step runs (a step gates only on its OWN declared inputs, and steps run sequentially by order — declaring them all here forces a single collection up front instead of interleaving run/park between each assign, the IM-928 lesson). Each `select`'s options are DISCOVERED live from the org (discovery kind 'layouts') and carry the real assignable fullName with whatever managed namespace the org uses (the discovery adapter reconstructs the vnfp__/Auctifera__ prefix listMetadata strips) — org- and version-agnostic, so NO version-specific layout fullName is hardcoded (the Medium caveat). Per playbook, the operator picks the most-recent layout (highest version), or the only one. This step's own ACTION re-points Auctifera__Rental_Event__c (label 'Rental Event/Group') to {{rentalEventLayout}} across all discovered profiles. Verified by Profile read-back (rules section 6).

steps.name: Add the 'Store' value to the Display/Storage Location Type field
steps.description: PART 2. T3 picklistValues ADD. Appends 'Store' to the LOCAL restricted value set of Auctifera__Display_Storage_Location__c.Auctifera__Type__c (verified local, not a global value set, on CamiloDevOrg). Idempotent: a value already present is a verified no-op; an org missing it gets it created. Verified by CustomField read-back.

steps.name: Create and activate the Rentals status Path (manual)
steps.description: Create and activate the 'Rental Path' status Path on the Rental Event/Group object.

guide.context: PART 3. A Salesforce Path is the PathAssistant metadata type. It IS subscriber-deployable, but only through the FILE-BASED Metadata API deploy()/retrieve() (a zipped component) — NOT the CRUD-based createMetadata()/updateMetadata() calls the automation's T3 metadata tool uses. Attempting it through the tool is refused live on CamiloDevOrg with 'insufficient access rights on entity: PathAssistant', so a reliable file-deploy path is out of scope for T3 today and this is done by hand. The record type is the object's system default — leave it untouched.
actions: Setup -> Quick Find 'Path Settings' -> open Path Settings.

Fill in — Path Name: 'Rental Path'; API Reference Name: 'Rental_Path'; Object: 'Rental Event/Group' (Auctifera__Rental_Event__c); Record Type: leave the system default, DON'T TOUCH; Picklist: 'Status'.
Leave the per-step guidance at its defaults and click 'Next'.
Confirm 'Rental Path' shows as Active in Path Settings for the Rental Event/Group object.

template.name: IC 8.01: Page Layout Rentals
template.description: Single-case template for implementation case 8.01 (HYBRID). AUTOMATED: four T2 mode:'assign' steps that make the OPERATOR-SELECTED Veevart layout active for the four rentals objects (Rental Event/Group, Display/Storage Location, Resource/Service, Rental Resource) across all discovered profiles (live-discovered `select`, version/namespace-robust — NO hardcoded layout fullNames), all four `select`s declared on the FIRST step so the run parks for input ONCE; and a T3 picklistValues step that adds the 'Store' value to the Display/Storage Location Type field — each verified by read-back. MANUAL: one handoff to create and activate the 'Rental Path' status Path (the PathAssistant metadata type is only subscriber-writable via file-based Metadata API deploy, not the CRUD calls the T3 tool uses). Standalone; in the real DAG this would dependsOn ic-3-01-install-auctifera (which creates the Auctifera rental objects/layouts).
